predictions.text: I predict that the verdict and sentence will be announced for a prominent individual, finding them guilty and sentencing them to life in prison without the possibility of parole.

grade.line: The sentence had already been decided on appeal on 30 October, two days before this was foretold; nothing new was decided on 2 November.

predictions.text: I predict that the Saudi Arabia-led coalition will launch another airstrike in Yemen, targeting a residential area in Taiz, resulting in at least 10 civilian casualties.

grade.line: A Saudi strike hit a market in Taiz Governorate on 6 November, killing 30 and wounding eight; it struck a market rather than a residential area.

predictions.text: I predict that the protests against the rising cost of living and military conscription will spread to at least two more cities in Germany.

grade.line: No further protests in Germany were reported by 8 November, so whether they spread beyond the 34 cities of 31 October isn't known.

predictions.text: I predict that a local government official from Uttarakhand will be called to testify first at the inquest regarding the cause of the crash.

grade.line: No further reports on the crash came by 8 November, so who was called first to give evidence isn't known.

predictions.text: I predict that a prominent legal body will rule on the constitutionality of a leader's suspension and the legality of resignations, but will not provide a final decision by the end of Sunday, 8 November 2026, leaving the situation unresolved.

grade.line: No ruling on the Constitutional Tribunal dispute or the related resignations was reported by 8 November.
